description: (Alpha, limited availability. If not enabled it returns an entitlement error; complete the task with the individual tools instead.) Use this when no other BrowserStack tool here fits, or when the ones you tried did not get you there. Prefer a specific tool whenever one fits. Describe the task in plain language. A data change asks you to confirm first: put it to the user, never decide for them; deletes are refused outright. If no one can confirm, the run is read-only and changes come back in `needs_approval`. One task per call.
